A service that parses an untrusted CCG lexicon string can be driven into tens of seconds of single-threaded CPU by a few-megabyte input, starving the request worker. No authentication or user interaction is required. ## Root Cause `matchBrackets` consumes a bracket body one character at a time with `inside = inside + r
